IbmDynamicalDecouplingIn.description: Dynamical decoupling options sent to Qiskit Runtime.
IbmDynamicalDecouplingIn.title: IbmDynamicalDecouplingIn

IbmOptionsIn.description:
Qiskit Runtime options for a job on an IBM Quantum device.

Every key is optional and no other key is accepted; absent or null keys are not sent.
IbmOptionsIn.title: IbmOptionsIn

IbmTwirlingIn.description:
Pauli twirling options sent to Qiskit Runtime.

With an enable flag true or a count given, both counts are required and their
product must equal the job's shots.
IbmTwirlingIn.title: IbmTwirlingIn

Method.description:
What the job computes. `run`: one expectation value per observable. `sample`:
measurement counts. `probabilities`: the probability of every basis state.
`zero_state_probability`: the probability of the all-zeros state.
`photonic_sample`: the photon counts of a linear-optical circuit, sampled on a
photonic device.
Method.title: Method

description:
The body of `POST /v1/jobs/estimate` and `POST /v1/jobs`: the device, the method,
the shots, and the circuit with its observables and parameter values. eigenkit
builds this body. Unknown fields answer 422 `validation_error`.

circuit_spec.description: The circuit, as eigenkit produces it: its `router` provider builds this value. The format is not specified here.
circuit_spec.title: Circuit Spec

device.description: A device ID from `GET /v1/devices`, for example `braket/sv1` or `ibm/ibm_fez`.
device.title: Device

ibm_options.description: Qiskit Runtime options, for an IBM Quantum device only. Any other device answers 422 `validation_error`. Absent or null sends no option.

inputs.description: The circuit's input values, one number per input, or `[]` when the circuit has none. Send a flat array, as for `weights`. With `photonic_sample` it may be a 2-D array, one row per run: the job runs every row and returns one result per row. More rows than the device takes answer 422 `batch_not_supported` with the limit in `details.max_rows`.
inputs.title: Inputs

observables.description: The observables, as eigenkit produces them: its `router` provider builds this value. The format is not specified here. At least one for every method except `photonic_sample`, which takes `[]`.
observables.title: Observables

shots.description: Shots for the vendor task. 0 asks a simulator for exact results with `run`, `probabilities` and `zero_state_probability`. `GET /v1/devices` lists the shots each method accepts on each device. For `photonic_sample` it is the samples asked for and the shot limit of each run, and a lossy device returns fewer samples than shots.
shots.title: Shots

weights.description: The circuit's weight values, one number per weight. Send a flat array: a device runs one parameter set per job, and a 2-D array answers 422 `batch_not_supported`.
weights.title: Weights
